name: Turbo kit (Kaze GT flat-four)
_note: A turbo kit made for the Kaze GT's flat-four: an equal-length manifold and a twin-scroll turbo — strong mid-range, the boxer rumble with a whistle over it.

sound._note: Its sound (garage/carSound.js, audio/dsp.js): whistle — the shaft's whistle, its pitch following the spool (which chases the boost the curve gives at the revs × how open the throttle is, spoolUp s to rise and spoolDown s to fall) from fromHz to toHz, its level (gain at full boost) the spool and the throttle; blowoff — the throttle shutting on boost: a valve's hiss sweeping down from hz ('valve'), or with no valve the compressor's flutter ('flutter'), gain × the spool, for about `seconds`.
